title: tolumnia intermedia
intro: Tolumnia intermedia, commonly known as the yellow passion orchid, is a species of orchid native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is known for its vibrant yellow flowers and is often used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Tolumnia intermedia include antioxidant, anti-ulcer, and anti-anxiety effects, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. Further research is needed to fully understand the extent of Tolumnia intermedia's medicinal properties and potential applications.
